reviews.comment: I am taking ECON675. He is a really great professor. His lectures are very detailed and makes everything really clear and easy to understand. The proofs are step by step. The prof's interpretation makes it easy to understand the intuition behind each concept. He also gives many real world examples to help understand the models.

I am taking the ECON675. His lectures are very detailed and every steps of explaining a concepts is very clear and proof is step by step. I can easily understand the intuition behind all concepts with his lectures. And he gives examples in real world to help understand the models. He is really a great professor. I enjoy taking his classes a lot.

Tests are short answer, so you definitely need to study. If you took Econometrics 461, the term paper should not be too bad. The recitation sections are helpful for getting feedback on your tests and term paper. Practice exams are provided and they are similar to the tests. It was a difficult class, but not impossible to do well.

Don't take this professor! The lectures are a mess and no one knows what is going on most of the time. The professor gives super complicated lectures that no one understands. The tests are really similar to the reviews. There are only 3 tests and one final essay. You can pass the class, but don't expect this to be an easy class.
Prof. An gave many examples on application of economics in real life, which I like it very much. The tests are difficult but practice tests are very useful.

This guy isn't amazing but he gets the job done. If you need this credit then I would take him. His lectures aren't amazing, but he's nice and answers questions. The research paper he assigns isn't too bad, its only around 10 pages. The final is worth 35% and the research paper is worth 35% and two tests during the year worth 30%. No homework ever.

Dr. An is a great professor! There are 3 pop-quizzes that proxy as attendance grades, the lowest is dropped. Mock exams are posted to Ecampus, but the tests are very challenging so it is important to understand "economic meaning" above all else. If you visit with him he is hilarious and easy going! I recommend having him review your research paper!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is a good teacher but his incredibly strong accent makes it very hard to understand what he is saying. 70% of your grade is a project and the final exam. The tests are incredibly hard and he gives 3 pop quizzes during the semester which are 10% of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
